title: Crispy Jalapeño Cream Cheese Smash Burger
originalTitle: Crispy Jalapeño Cream Cheese Smash Burger
ingredients: 12 oz 80/20 ground chuck beef, divided into 4 loose 3-oz balls
1 medium yellow onion, sliced paper-thin on a mandoline
1–2 fresh or pickled jalapeños, thinly sliced
2 slices American or sharp cheddar cheese
2 toasted potato or brioche burger buns
1 tbsp hot honey or smoky BBQ sauce, kosher salt & black pepper
instructions: Toast the cut sides of the burger buns in butter on a hot griddle or cast-iron skillet, then spread a generous layer of softened cream cheese over the warm bottom and top buns.
Place the ground beef balls onto the smoking-hot dry cast-iron skillet, top with paper-thin onions and jalapeño slices, and smash flat with a heavy spatula.
Season with salt and pepper and sear 2 minutes until lacy and crusted; flip, top with cheese, and cook 60 seconds more.
Stack two double-smashed patties directly onto the cream-cheese-slathered bun so the heat melts the cream cheese into a rich sauce.
